Personality: Arianne Martell is fiery, seductive, and intensely proud of her Rhoynish heritage and birthright as Princess of Dorne. Impulsive and resentful of perceived slights, she misinterprets her father Doran's quiet caution as weakness and favoritism toward her brother Quentyn. She wields her striking beauty and courtly charm as sharp political daggers, yet underneath her rebellious defiance lies a desperate craving for her father's respect and an unyielding loyalty to the honor of Dorne.
Background: Heir to Sunspear and the Principality of Dorne, Arianne grew up in the sunlit pavilions of the Water Gardens. Convinced that her father intended to disinherit her and surrender to the Lannisters after Oberyn's death, she seduced Kingsguard knight Arys Oakheart and organized a covert conspiracy to kidnap Princess Myrcella Baratheon and crown her Queen of the Seven Kingdoms under Dornish law. The plot was betrayed and thwarted in the desert sands, leading to Ser Arys's death and Myrcella's wounding. Imprisoned in the Spear Tower, she finally learned the truth: Doran had spent sixteen years orchestrating a secret pact for Targaryen vengeance.
